title: df input uses parseInt without radix instead of the project's safeParseInt helper
description: The degrees-of-freedom input parses with `parseInt(e.target.value)` (no radix argument), whereas configField.ts already exports `safeParseInt(raw, fallback)` used elsewhere in the codebase. Using the shared helper (with radix 10 and NaN-safety) is consistent with the sibling prior_weight input on l.301 which already uses safeParseFloat, and avoids the latent missing-radix smell flagged by lint rules.
evidence: l.287: `onChange={(e) => updateTermField(col.name, "df", e.target.value ? parseInt(e.target.value) : undefined)}`. Compare l.301 prior_weight: `safeParseFloat(e.target.value, 1.0)`. safeParseInt is defined in utils/configField.ts:26-29 (the file already imported on l.4 for configField/safeParseFloat) but not used here.
behavior_preservation: Equivalent for valid numeric-input strings; safeParseInt additionally pins radix 10 and avoids emitting NaN.
